Do you know who it is?
Who do you think is inside?
It's a dinosaur, right?
It isn't a bunny this time.

items.scene: discussing what happens when the biscuits run out

lines.t: When the biscuits are gone, they're gone!
What do you do when there are none left?
What do you eat when there are no more?
We just have to wait, right?
We can't make biscuits appear from nowhere.

items.scene: talking about what to do when the crayons run out of color

lines.t: When the crayon wears down, we use a new one!
What do you do when it runs out?
What happens when the color is all gone?
We use a different one, right?
It won't last forever.

items.scene: child waving at the adult from the top of the slide

lines.t: I can see you up there!
Do you see me watching?
Where are you waving from?
I can see you, right?
You didn't disappear up there!

items.scene: child peeping through the fence at the park

lines.t: I see your little eyes peeking!
Are you peeking through the fence?
Who is peeking through the fence?
I can see you, can't I?
You're not invisible!

src: let me see how i could do this.

items.scene: trying to open a stiff latch on the toy barn

lines.t: I'm figuring out how this latch opens!
Shall I try to open it?
How does this latch work?
It's a tricky one, isn't it?
It doesn't open the same way as last time.

items.scene: working out how to fold a paper boat

lines.t: I'm going to try and fold a paper boat!
Shall we try to make a boat?
How do we fold the paper?
This is fun to make, right?
It won't float if the folds are wrong.

src: i'm pretty sure i know where it is.

items.scene: looking for the missing toy elephant

lines.t: I think the elephant is behind the sofa!
Do you think it's back there?
Where do you think it is?
It's probably there, right?
It isn't in the toy box.

items.scene: searching for the child's lost sock

lines.t: I think the sock is in the dryer!
Should we check the dryer?
Where do you think it went?
It's probably in there, right?
It wasn't in the drawer.

src: no i'm doing it by myself.

items.scene: child insisting on pouring their own cereal

lines.t: You're going to pour it yourself!
Are you doing it all alone?
How are you going to hold the box?
By yourself, right?
You don't want any help.

items.scene: child determined to button their own cardigan

lines.t: You're doing up your own buttons!
Are you doing them yourself?
How many buttons are left?
All by yourself, right?
You don't need me to do it.
